<title>Antsurance</title>

<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part1.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part2.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part3.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part4.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />



<!-- branding stylesheets-->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/print.css }" media="print"/>

<style id="antsurance-root">html { font-size: 100%; } body { margin: 0; background: #faf9f5; }</style>
<style id="antsurance-login">
/* The sign-in page: Antsurance's own colors and type on Salesforce's sign-in form. Nothing stock blue.
   The form's own styles are more specific than anything written here, so what they set is overridden with !important. */
community_byo-scoped-header-and-footer > header, community_byo-scoped-header-and-footer > footer { display: none; }
main:has(community_login-login-form) community_layout-column > .column-content { box-sizing: border-box !important; width: 100% !important; max-width: 29.5rem !important; margin: 0 auto !important; padding: 10vh 1.25rem 2rem !important; }
main:has(community_login-login-form) .component-wrapper-spacer { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; }
community_login-login-form.comm-login-form { display: block; }
community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__container { max-width: none !important; min-height: 0 !important; max-height: none !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #e8e6dc; border-top: 3px solid #d97757; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #fff; box-shadow: none; }
community_login-login-form .slds-form-element__label { padding: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: #141413; }
community_login-login-form lightning-input + lightning-input { margin-top: 1rem; }
community_login-login-form .slds-input { height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #c9c6ba; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: #fff; color: #141413; font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: none; }
community_login-login-form .slds-input:focus { border-color: #ae5f46; outline: 2px solid #ae5f46; outline-offset: 1px; box-shadow: none; }
community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__login-button { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #d97757 !important; border-radius: 0.625rem; background-color: #d97757 !important; color: #141413 !important; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; }
community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__login-button:hover, community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__login-button:focus { border-color: #ae5f46 !important; background-color: #ae5f46 !important; color: #faf9f5 !important; }
community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__login-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ae5f46; outline-offset: 2px; }
community_login-login-form .comm-login-form__login-button:active { border-color: #8a4a35 !important; background-color: #8a4a35 !important; color: #faf9f5 !important; }
community_login-login-form a, community_login-login-form a:visited { color: #8a4a35 !important; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(138, 74, 53, 0.4); text-underline-offset: 0.18em; }
community_login-login-form a:hover, community_login-login-form a:focus { color: #ae5f46 !important; text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
community_login-login-form hr, community_login-login-form .slds-border_top { border-color: #e8e6dc; }
community_login-login-form .slds-has-error .slds-form-element__help { color: #8a4a35; }
</style>
